final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.throws, ''), '(blank or missing)') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.throws, ''), '(blank or missing)')), shares AS (SELECT hand, award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT hand, award_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > avg_share
